trace.detail:
MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services team,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our Master Services Agreement, currently in effect from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026.

We are open to renewing for a further 12 months under Clause 8.1. However, the proposed 12% increase (from Rs 24,00,000 to Rs 26,88,000 annually, i.e. Rs 2,24,000/month) exceeds the 7% price cap set out in Clause 8.2, which permits increases beyond this threshold only by mutual written agreement. We are not prepared to accept 12% at this time.

Separately, per Clause 4.1 (99.9% monthly uptime target) and Clause 4.2 (5% service credit per month below target), your reported uptime fell short in May 2026 (99.42%) and July 2026 (99.61%). This entitles us to service credits of Rs 20,000 (2 months × Rs 10,000), which have not yet been applied against our account. We request these be credited against the current or renewal invoice.

Regarding pricing, we have received competitive market quotes for comparable services in the range of Rs 2,10,804 to Rs 2,15,595 per month, both above your current rate of Rs 2,00,000/month. Given this, and the SLA misses noted above, we propose renewal at no more than a 7% increase (Rs 25,68,000 annually, Rs 2,14,000/month), inclusive of the Rs 20,000 service credit adjustment.

Please confirm your acceptance of these terms, or propose a revised offer within the 7% cap, so we can finalize the renewal ahead of the 31 October 2026 expiry.

Regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
